\section{Declared assumptions and conditional adequacy}
\label{sec:assumptions}

These are bounded assumptions of the v0.1 scientific object, not achieved
claims.  If a required assumption is false, unsupported, or unavailable, the
dependent output is unavailable or fails closed as stated by the requirements.

\Assumption{001}{Authoritative upstream selection}{The exact
\nolinkurl{SCI-ALIGN_TO_SCI-AST v0.1/r0.1} bundle,
pointing-support record selection, physical-center selection, frame plan, RTC
plan when used, and MAP projection plan when used are supplied by their named
authorities.  AST validates and consumes these selections but does not create
them.  The exact per-family center owner remains open under
\texttt{AST-OWNER-Q002}.}

\Assumption{002}{Exact aligned field registry}{Every required boresight and
current observing-state field arrives with stable identity, registry version,
unit, unchanged producer frame, topology, operator, source relation, support,
origin, validity, and uncertainty availability.  The exact registry and
composition-history semantics remain open under \texttt{AST-OWNER-Q001};
outputs needing an unresolved field are unavailable rather than inferred.}

\Assumption{003}{Immutable selected geometry}{A selected geometry instance is
bound to one immutable APT realization and complete approved lineage.  The
exact producer, association authority/schema, and cross-realization transform
remain open under \texttt{AST-OWNER-Q006}; an unresolved instance cannot be
used unconditionally.}

\Assumption{004}{No hidden commutation}{The ordered composition in
Section~\ref{sec:ordered-composition} is physical authority.  Zero-offset or
infinitesimal cases are limiting cases only and do not authorize reordering,
double application, or removal of lineage.}

\Assumption{005}{Bounded small-angle production}{The established small-angle
production relation is admissible only under a preregistered record naming the
field/elevation/time domain, detector population, coordinate and pixel error
metrics, required product use, tolerance owner and value, and fail-closed
behavior.  Exact spherical composition is the independent offline oracle.
The owner and quantitative record remain open under
\texttt{AST-OWNER-Q004}; no universal threshold or automatic fallback is
created here.}

\Assumption{006}{Time adequacy}{A time representation is adequate only when a
preregistered angular-error analysis bounds the induced astrometric error for
the named use.  Unused digits and an arbitrary microsecond target are not
authority.  The quantitative time bound remains unavailable under
\texttt{AST-OWNER-Q004}.}

\Assumption{007}{Large-array precision adequacy}{Compact WCS authorities and
fitted/catalog coordinates use adequate high precision.  A representation for
large coordinate arrays is admitted only after a preregistered empirical
coordinate/pixel adequacy bound for the required product use.  The bound
remains unavailable under \texttt{AST-OWNER-Q004}.}

\Assumption{008}{Named frame semantics}{A requested frame transform is
available only with declared source/target identities, epoch/equinox, time
scale, site, model/version, input availability, and EOP/refraction
applicability.  Ordinary native AltAz paths do not acquire unnecessary
EOP/refraction requirements, and missing equatorial authority is not repaired
by relabeling.}

\Assumption{009}{TAN operating support}{The mathematical forward TAN domain is
finite $D>0$.  A product may impose a tighter footprint-derived operating
support only through a separately preregistered authority, metric, and failure
rule.  This package invents no positive universal $D_{\min}$.}

\Assumption{010}{Conditional uncertainty}{Only explicitly available
map-center input covariance and cross-covariance terms are propagated.  The
producer, conditioning, and per-family availability of those terms remain
open under \texttt{AST-OWNER-Q003}.  Unavailable is not zero.}

\Assumption{011}{Typed Jacobian request}{A map-center Jacobian exists as an
available product only after a named family requests exact input/output
domains, axis order, units, and direction.  Those family-specific requests
remain open under \texttt{AST-OWNER-Q007}.}

\Assumption{012}{RTC role is explicit}{RTC-grid coordinates or response-aware
use exist only for named families with an exact RTC profile instance.  The
requesting families and profile owner remain open under
\texttt{AST-OWNER-Q008}.  Missing RTC parent facts do not alter unrelated
ALIGN-grid coordinate availability.}

\Assumption{013}{MAP-specific retained-grid policy is external}{The deferred
MAP-003 retained-WCS/crop/dual-axis disposition under
\texttt{AST-OWNER-Q005} is not supplied by this v0.1 authority.  Any later
requirement that changes AST admission or parentage requires a named amendment;
until then, MAP cropping and retained-grid policy remain MAP-owned.}

\Assumption{014}{Ordinary nonpolarimetric coordinate scope}{Only the ordinary nonpolarimetric coordinate path
is admitted.  AST does not interpret
polarization. Optional HWPR timing may remain only as an ALIGN-parent fact;
no demodulation, polarization calibration or response, or Stokes reconstruction
is authorized. In particular, raw KID readout $x$ is not identified as Stokes
I. Galactic simulation, general reprojection, source fitting, calibration,
photometry, beam inference, and map accumulation are outside this authority.}

\Assumption{015}{No achieved-status inference}{Compilation, document
verification, a plausible image, a downstream fit, or existing operational
use cannot establish scientific approval, implementation conformity,
observational performance, validation, freeze, or production readiness.}
